title: 第十一章枯木逢春
novel_title: 开局阴阳宗，从反杀师姐开始斩妖除魔
content_zh:
张守安走出屋子，抬头一望，外面的阳光非常刺眼，照得张守安有些睁不开眼睛。

    他伸出左手手微微挡住了洒下的阳光，右手提着还在流血的猪头，步步向外走去。

    穿过满院的杂草，还有深长的街巷，他再一次来到了老人面前。

    他将猪头往地上一扔，看着对面的老人，没有一丝表情。

    老人依旧站在那里，杵着拐杖，佝偻着背，像是在等着什么。

    自从张守安进入那个大院后，他就一直在这里等着，他也不知道自己在期待什么，但乱跳的心脏似乎说出了答案。

    他必须亲耳听到，亲眼看见看见那个结果。

    不过他也做好了最坏的打算。

    若是那个仙长没出来，那自己就冒险进去，把仙长的骨头拖出来。

    他是为了枯木村死的，就算是枯木村的恩人。

    自己有义务进去，大不了到时候再拼上老骨头，热血一把。

    他的手指攥紧拐杖，眼神直直地盯着那个方向。似乎是像透过那重重的院墙，看清最中央那处古宅里的场景。

    当那个年轻仙长的身影出现后，他的整个身影都开始微微颤抖。

    而当他看清仙长扔在地上的东西之时，他的身体简直不受控制一般，自己往前迈步。

    “啪嗒”拐杖摔在了地上，他踉跄地向前走出几步，声音颤抖：

    “死了，猪妖死了，猪妖终于死了。”

    他刚走出几步，却突然一步走空，整个人直接摔在了地上，惹得满脸尘土。

    但他没有多么停留，而是赶紧爬起，爬向地上那团东西。

    他一爬近，就直接抓住猪头的耳朵，一拳又一拳地捶在猪头上。

    虽然没有多少力气，但这每一拳都似乎宣泄出了他的所有。

    “死怪物，死怪物，你给我死，给我死！”一拳接上一拳，不久，猪头就被打得烂了一大片。

    慢慢地老人哭了出来：“为什么，为什么要吃我的孙女。”

    “妍妍，猪妖死了，仙长替你报仇了。”

    他喃喃着，张守安站在一旁，耐心听着。

    妖物祸乱，对修士来说不算什么，不过对寻常百姓来说，却是生死危机。

    更何况，还有魔门这种人妖勾结之事。本来只是妖祸，再加上修士的联合压榨，百姓怎么生存，又如何生存。

    他敢肯定，这种事绝对不在少数，自己今天的发现，只是其中一个案例。

    自己能做什么？
content_en:
Zhang Shou'an walked out of the house and looked up. The sunlight outside was very dazzling, making it difficult for Zhang Shou'an to open his eyes.

He stretched out his left hand to slightly block the sunlight, holding the still bleeding pig head in his right hand, and walked out step by step.

After passing through the weeds in the yard and the long streets, he came to the old man again.

He threw the pig's head to the ground and looked at the old man opposite without any expression.

The old man was still standing there, holding his cane and hunching his back, as if waiting for something.

Ever since Zhang Shouan entered the compound, he had been waiting here. He didn't know what he was expecting, but his beating heart seemed to tell the answer.

He must hear it with his own ears and see it with his own eyes.

But he also prepared for the worst.

If the immortal doesn't come out, then he will risk going in and drag out the immortal's bones.

He died for Deadwood Village, even though he was the benefactor of Deadwood Village.

I have an obligation to go in. At worst, I will fight with my old bones and blood when the time comes.

His fingers tightened on the crutches and his eyes stared straight in that direction.It was as if one could clearly see the scene in the ancient house in the center through the heavy courtyard walls.

When the figure of the young immortal appeared, his whole figure began to tremble slightly.

And when he saw clearly what the immortal threw on the ground, his body was almost out of control and he stepped forward on his own.

"Pa ta" the crutch fell to the ground. He staggered a few steps forward, his voice trembling:

"Dead, the pig demon is dead, the pig demon is finally dead."

He had just taken a few steps, but suddenly he missed a step and fell directly to the ground, causing his face to be covered with dust.

But he didn't stop for long, but quickly got up and crawled towards the mass on the ground.

As soon as he got closer, he grabbed the pig's head directly by its ears and punched the pig's head again and again.

Although he didn't have much strength, each punch seemed to release everything he had.

"Damn monster, dead monster, die to me, die to me!" One punch followed another, and soon, a large piece of the pig's head was broken.

Slowly the old man cried: "Why, why do you want to eat my granddaughter?"

"Yanyan, the pig demon is dead, and the immortal has avenged you."

He murmured, Zhang Shou'an stood aside and listened patiently.

Monster troubles are nothing to monks, but to ordinary people, they are a life and death crisis.

What's more, there is also the collusion between humans and demons like the Demon Sect.It was originally just a demonic disaster, and coupled with the joint oppression of the monks, how could the people survive and how could they survive.

He was sure that this kind of thing was definitely not rare, and what he discovered today was just one of them.

What can I do?
